businessMeaning: Packaging has moved from back-end commodity to the binding constraint on accelerator performance; buyers should secure capacity before committing to a multi-die design.
investmentLens: Substrate, bonding and test capacity are the scarce assets; the memory and foundry leaders with captive packaging lines are best placed to capture the premium.
